title: Canonical Feed severity and urgency mapping
changes: Added one shared feed severity contract with deterministic aliases, rank, attention class, presentation class and interrupt intent.
Unified Decision Feed now derives risk, urgency and significance sort ranks through the shared severity contract while retaining legacy level fields.
Workforce notification wrapper now accepts canonical severity inputs, adapts them to the proven Pass 39 urgency runtime, and enriches outputs with canonical severity envelopes.
No notification, Feed, decision or severity signal grants authority or execution permission.
